fields.label: Export Scenario Information as HTML
fields.help: Check this box to have the model export scenario properties and snapshots of results to linked HTML files. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Date/Time for HTML Exports
fields.help: Indicate the date and time during the simulation when the model will export scenario properties and results snapshots to linked HTML files. Typically this is some time near the end of the simulation, when certain meteorological and abiotic events are occurring (e.g., rainfall so that you can observe wet deposition algorithms; winds are blowing from the emission source toward the watershed so you can observe deposition onto the watershed; it is daytime and during the period of "allow exchange" so that you can observe plant leaf interactions with airborne chemical; etc.)

fields.label: Length of Time Before End of Simulation for HTML Exports
Calculate Averaged Results
fields.help: Check this box to have the model calculate time-averaged results. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Number of Simulation Time Steps in Each Output Time Step
fields.help: Enter the frequency of simulation time steps when outputs will be exported.

fields.label: Averaging Interval for Results
fields.help: Enter the averaging time for time-averaged results (must be at least as large as the simulation time step). Typically "annual"; other options are "monthly", or whole numbers (in hours).

fields.label: Significant Digits for Results
fields.help: Enter the number of significant digits to include in outputs (e.g., a value of 13.0417829 would display as 1.304E1 if set to 4 significant digits)

fields.label: Display Time-Steps as the First Results Field
fields.help: Check this box to display the time step as the first field in the results files (rather than the compartment names). This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Export Outdoor Environment Definitions
fields.help: Check this box if you want to export your simulation's volume elements, compartments, and links and their algorithms to delimited files. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Export Scenario Properties
fields.help: Check this box if you want to export your simulation's scenario properties and formulas to delimited files. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Export Concentration Results
fields.help: Check this box to export results of simulated concentrations. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Export Deposition Results
fields.help: Check this box to export simulated deposition results. This feature is typically used.

fields.label: Export Chemical Mass Results
fields.help: Check this box to export results of simulated chemical mass. This feature is typically used.
